highlights: Compliance with Child Protection Act B.E. 2546 and EDT Accreditation Standards 2025
Zero tolerance policy for abuse and neglect
safety.policy_summary: The Child Protection Policy outlines the standards, responsibilities, and procedures that guide all staff, teachers, and school personnel in safeguarding children, complying with Thai legislation, international child rights standards, and Educational Development Trust (EDT) Accreditation Standards 2025.
